# Awesome AI Apps [![Awesome](https://awesome.re/badge.svg)](https://awesome.re) **141 runnable LLM apps and agents, from 5-minute framework starters to production-grade multi-agent systems.** [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Arindam200/awesome-ai-apps?style=flat&logo=github&label=Stars&color=yellow)](https://github.com/Arindam200/awesome-ai-apps/stargazers) [![Forks](https://img.shields.io/github/forks/Arindam200/awesome-ai-apps?style=flat&logo=github&label=Forks)](https://github.com/Arindam200/awesome-ai-apps/network/members) [![Contributors](https://img.shields.io/github/contributors/Arindam200/awesome-ai-apps?style=flat&label=Contributors&color=blueviolet)](#-contributors) [![Last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/Arindam200/awesome-ai-apps?style=flat&label=Last%20commit&color=brightgreen)](https://github.com/Arindam200/awesome-ai-apps/commits/main) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/github/license/Arindam200/awesome-ai-apps?style=flat&label=License&color=blue)](LICENSE) [![PRs welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen?style=flat)](CONTRIBUTING.md) [**Browse projects**](#-browse-by-category) · [**Quick start**](#-quick-start) · [**Contribute**](#-contributing) · [**Sponsor**](#-sponsors) · [**Newsletter**](#-stay-updated)
Awesome AI Apps is a hands-on collection of projects, tutorials and recipes for building LLM-powered applications: text agents, voice assistants, RAG apps, MCP tools and fine-tuning pipelines. Each project lives in its own folder with a README, its own dependencies and a `.env.example`, so you can clone the repo, open one folder and run it.

[Docker cagent Multi-Agent Starter](starter_ai_agents/cagent_starter): Open-source customizable multi-agent runtime by Docker - [DSPy Optimization Starter](starter_ai_agents/dspy_starter): DSPy framework for building and optimizing AI systems - [Mastra Tool-Calling Starter](starter_ai_agents/mastra_starter): TypeScript-first agent with a custom tool powered by Nebius Token Factory - [Microsoft Agent Framework Starter](starter_ai_agents/microsoft_agents_starter): Multi-agent travel planning demos built on Microsoft Agent Framework - [OpenAI Agents SDK Starter](starter_ai_agents/openai_agents_sdk): OpenAI Agents SDK with email helper and haiku writer examples - [PydanticAI Weather Bot](starter_ai_agents/pydantic_starter): Real-time weather information agent - [Sayna Realtime Voice Agent](starter_ai_agents/sayna_starter): Real-time voice infrastructure with multi-provider STT/TTS (Deepgram, ElevenLabs, Azure, Google) and WebSocket streaming - [Semantic Kernel Starter](starter_ai_agents/semantic_kernel_starter): Microsoft Semantic Kernel `ChatCompletionAgent` with plugin-based tool calling ### 🪶 Simple Agents **Straightforward, practical use-cases for everyday AI applications.** _21 projects_ - [VoyageCompass Travel Planner](simple_ai_agents/nebius_travel_planner): LangChain and Nebius travel planner with weather, research, currency conversion, budgets, and packing tools - [Web Automation Agent](simple_ai_agents/browser_agent): Browser automation agent using Nebius and browser-use ### 🎙️ Voice Agents **Real-time voice assistants and streaming speech pipelines**, including LiveKit, Pipecat, Gradium, and [VoxCode](voice_agents/Cursor_code_editor) (Deepgram + Cursor SDK). _9 projects_ - [Workflow Audit Trail (FlowSentinel)](advance_ai_agents/flowsentinal_audittrail): Next.js workflow command center with Nebius Nemotron reasoning, n8n orchestration, Velt activity logs, and optional Tailscale Funnel exposure ### 🧬 Fine-Tuning **End-to-end examples of fine-tuning open-source LLMs, from data prep to deployment.** _6 projects_ - [Customer Support Fine-Tuning with Data Lab](fine_tuning/customer_support_datalab): Teacher-student distillation workflow to generate support data, curate it in Data Lab, fine-tune, and deploy - [Insurance Claims Fine-Tuning](fine_tuning/insurance_claims_finetuning): Data Lab, LoRA fine-tuning, and a Gradio comparison app for insurance claims - [Open-Source LLM Fine-Tuning on Token Factory](fine_tuning/open_source_llms_token_factory): Colab-first LoRA fine-tuning walkthrough to upload a dataset, train, monitor, and deploy - [Standalone Customer Support Fine-Tuning (Colab)](fine_tuning/customer_support_standalone_colab): Fully standalone Colab notebook for the customer-support distillation and fine-tuning flow ## 📺 Tutorials & Videos ### 🎓 Course Playlists - [**AWS Strands Course**](course/aws_strands): Complete 8-lesson course on building AI agents with AWS Strands SDK ([watch the playlist](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLMZM1DAlf0Lrc43ZtUXAwYu9DhnqxzRKZ)) - [**Voice Agents Playlist**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c6t4q0tE61E&list=PLKCdxubW1354): Tutorials on building voice agents ### 🔧 Framework Tutorials - [**AI Agents, MCP and more...**](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL2ambAOfYA6-LDz0KpVKu9vJKAqhv0KKI): Mixed tutorials and project demos - [**Build AI Agents**](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLMZM1DAlf0LqixhAG9BDk4O_FjqnaogK8): General AI agent development tutorials - [**Build with MCP**](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLMZM1DAlf0Lolxax4L2HS54Me8gn1gkz4): Model Context Protocol tutorials and examples ## ⚡ Quick Start You need **Python 3.10+**, **[uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/)** or `pip`, and the API keys listed in the project's README. Most projects run on [Nebius Token Factory](https://dub.sh/nebius). ```bash # 1. Clone the repo and pick a project git clone https://github.com/Arindam200/awesome-ai-apps.git cd awesome-ai-apps/starter_ai_agents/agno_starter # 2. Add your API keys cp .env.example .env # 3. Install dependencies uv sync # or: pip install -r requirements.txt # 4. Run it (each project's README has the exact command) uv run main.py # or: python main.py / streamlit run app.py ``` ## 🤝 Contributing We welcome contributions from the community! Here's how you can help: - 💡 **Add a new project**: a self-contained, runnable example with its own README, dependencies and `.env.example` - 🔧 **Fix issues**: code improvements and bug fixes for existing projects - 📝 **Improve documentation**: help make projects easier to set up and understand - 🐛 **Report bugs** or suggest improvements via [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Arindam200/awesome-ai-apps/issues) Before you open a PR, read the [Contributing Guidelines](CONTRIBUTING.md), check existing issues to avoid duplicates, and follow the [project README template](.github/README_TEMPLATE.md). This project follows a [Contributor Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md); by participating, you agree to abide by its terms. ## 🌟 Contributors Awesome AI Apps is built by its community.
